title: C: Rate Limiter (Token Bucket)
description: Implement a token bucket rate limiter that controls how many operations can be performed per second.

steps.title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
steps.description: Define a `TokenBucket` struct with capacity, tokens, and fill rate. Write `int allow_request(TokenBucket *tb)` that consumes a token if available. Simulate 8 requests with bucket capacity of 5: first 5 should be allowed, next 3 denied.
hints: Tokens fill up over time (simulate with a counter).
Refill tokens each call up to capacity.
